page.overview:
Who is Corn Syrup Wizard?

Corn Syrup Wizard is a character who appeared in Issue 12 of the Adventure Time comic book series. He registered to take part in the wizard battle being organized by Finn, Jake and Marceline during their search for Ewlbo. He was apparently responsible for messing up Marceline's pies, so she beats him up when he appears at the registration.

Corn Syrup Wizard is a strange-looking orange blob of what is presumably corn syrup. He wears a red cloak and has a blue gem attached to a belt around his neck.
